parameters.jsCode: const c=$input.first().json;if(!['demo','live'].includes(c.mode))throw Error('mode must be demo or live');if(c.mode==='live'&&c.allowPaidProcessing!==true)throw Error('Review provider pricing, then set allowPaidProcessing=true');if(c.mode==='live'&&!/^https:\/\//.test(c.providerBaseUrl))throw Error('Live providerBaseUrl must use HTTPS');if(!Array.isArray(c.briefs)||c.briefs.length<1||c.briefs.length>5)throw Error('Use 1-5 briefs');const seen=new Set();for(const b of c.briefs){if(!/^[a-z0-9_-]{1,64}$/i.test(b.jobId)||seen.has(b.jobId))throw Error('Each jobId must be unique and safe');seen.add(b.jobId);if(typeof b.prompt!=='string'||b.prompt.trim().length<20||b.prompt.length>1500)throw Error('Each prompt must be 20-1500 characters');if(![5,6,8,10].includes(Number(b.durationSeconds)))throw Error('durationSeconds must be 5, 6, 8 or 10');if(!['16:9','9:16','1:1'].includes(b.aspectRatio))throw Error('Unsupported aspectRatio');if(!Number.isInteger(b.seed)||b.seed<0||b.seed>2147483647)throw Error('seed must be a non-negative integer');}return [{json:c}];

const responses=$input.all(),reqs=$('Build traceable requests').all();return responses.map((item,n)=>{const r=reqs[n].json,x=item.json,status=Number(x.statusCode||0),body=x.body||{};let state='submission_unconfirmed';if(status>=200&&status<300)state=(body.id||body.jobId||body.request_id)?'accepted':'invalid_success_response';else if(status>=400&&status<500)state='rejected';else if(status>=500)state='provider_error';return {json:{...r,state,httpStatus:status,providerJobId:body.id||body.jobId||body.request_id||null,resultUrl:body.resultUrl||body.outputUrl||null,warning:['submission_unconfirmed','provider_error'].includes(state)?'Check the provider dashboard before retrying; automatic POST retries are disabled.':null},pairedItem:{item:n}};});

return $input.all().map((item,n)=>({json:{jobId:item.json.jobId||item.json.shotId||('item-'+(n+1)),state:item.json.state,providerJobId:item.json.providerJobId||null,resultUrl:item.json.resultUrl||null,request:item.json.request,reviewRequired:true,createdAt:new Date().toISOString(),notice:'Review output, usage rights and provider receipt before publication or retry.'},pairedItem:{item:n}}));

parameters.content:
## Purpose
Turn one to five production-ready text-to-video briefs into validated, idempotent provider jobs and a review manifest. It checks prompt length, supported durations, aspect ratios, job identifiers and seeds before any network call. The workflow is useful for teams that need predictable batch inputs rather than ad-hoc prompt copying.

## Setup
The default demo runs completely offline and returns fixture video URLs, so it is safe to inspect without credentials or charges. For live use, replace providerBaseUrl with an authorized video-generation API that accepts POST requests, attach an n8n Header Auth credential to the HTTP node, review pricing, and set allowPaidProcessing=true. Keep API keys only in n8n credentials. The example contract sends prompt, durationSeconds, aspectRatio and seed and expects an ID and optional result URL.

## Reliability
Every request includes a deterministic Idempotency-Key. Automatic POST retries are disabled to avoid duplicate paid jobs. Non-2xx, malformed and ambiguous responses remain explicit in the final manifest and require checking the provider dashboard before retrying. The workflow does not publish generated media.

## Attribution
Created by Shisan Hua, who works on [Dola AI Video](https://www.dolai.video/). This template uses a generic authorized provider contract and does not claim that Dola AI Video exposes a public API.
